description.zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为[CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~)返回的任务**ID**。也可通过[ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the deployment job. The **ID** of the job is returned after you call the [CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~) operation. You can also call the [ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~) operation to obtain the ID.
